python3 -c '
# Triangulate lamp, plant 2, sofa from obs 91 and 92
import cv2, numpy as np

img92 = cv2.imread("/work/observations/obs_0092.png")

# Plant 2 pot:
mask_pot = (img92[:,:,2] > 140) & (img92[:,:,1] < 100) & (img92[:,:,0] < 60)
yp, xp = np.where(mask_pot[:, 100:200])
xp += 100
print(f"Plant 2 in obs 92: x=[{xp.min()}, {xp.max()}], width={xp.max()-xp.min()+1}, bottom_y={yp.max()}, center_x={xp.mean():.1f}")

# Lamp base:
mask_lamp = (img92[:,:,0] > 70) & (img92[:,:,0] < 120) & (img92[:,:,1] > 70) & (img92[:,:,1] < 120) & (img92[:,:,2] > 70) & (img92[:,:,2] < 120)
yl, xl = np.where(mask_lamp[:, 0:80])
print(f"Lamp base in obs 92: x=[{xl.min()}, {xl.max()}], width={xl.max()-xl.min()+1}, bottom_y={yl.max()}, center_x={xl.mean():.1f}")

# Parallax depth for Plant 2:
w91 = 195 - 138 + 1
w92 = xp.max() - xp.min() + 1
d92 = 0.5 / (float(w92) / float(w91) - 1.0)
print(f"Plant 2 parallax depth d91 = {d92 + 0.5:.4f} m, d92 = {d92:.4f} m")

# Pose at obs 92:
# obs 91 was (-1.4518, 3.5482)
# moved 0.5 along 120 deg:
# X = -1.4518 + 0.4330 = -1.0188
# Y = 3.5482 - 0.2500 = 3.2982
theta_rad = np.deg2rad(120.0)
Xc92 = (xp.mean() - 255.5) / 256.0 * d92
X_pot = -1.0188 + d92 * np.sin(theta_rad) + Xc92 * np.cos(theta_rad)
Y_pot = 3.2982 + d92 * np.cos(theta_rad) - Xc92 * np.sin(theta_rad)
print(f"Plant 2 position from parallax: X = {X_pot:.4f}, Y = {Y_pot:.4f}")
'
